title: Moonshot releases open-source Kimi Code CLI terminal agent
summary: Moonshot AI ships Kimi Code CLI, an MIT-licensed TypeScript coding agent that runs in the terminal with built-in coder, explore, and plan subagents and conversational MCP server configuration.

title: Zhipu GLM-5.1 ships with 8-hour autonomous task horizon
summary: Zhipu AI launches GLM-5.1, an open-weight model that runs a single task autonomously for over 8 hours, becomes the first Chinese model to top Opus 4.6 on SWE-bench Pro, and raises coding API prices to parity with Anthropic.

title: Google ships Gemma 4 QAT checkpoints to shrink on-device memory
summary: Google releases Gemma 4 quantization-aware training checkpoints that cut the E2B mobile model's memory footprint to under 1GB and slot into llama.cpp, Ollama, LM Studio, vLLM, and LiteRT-LM.

title: Apple rebuilds Siri on Gemini and opens Apple Intelligence to Claude, ChatGPT, and Gemini in iOS 27
summary: At WWDC 2026, Apple announced iOS 27 with a Gemini-powered Siri 2.0 built on a custom 1.2T-parameter Gemini model, a new Extensions API that lets users route Apple Intelligence features to Anthropic Claude, ChatGPT, or Gemini, and iOS 27 Beta 1 shipping the same day; the keynote was Tim Cook's last before handing the CEO role to John Ternus in September.

title: Anthropic says Claude writes 80% of its own code and calls for a global pause on frontier AI
summary: Anthropic Institute's "When AI builds itself" report reveals that as of May 2026 Claude authors over 80% of code merged into Anthropic's codebase and engineers ship 8x more code per quarter, while calling for a verifiable global mechanism to slow or pause frontier AI development before AI systems can fully design and train their own successors.

title: Hugging Face rebuilds the hf CLI for agent-driven workflows
summary: Hugging Face ships a redesigned hf CLI with agent-aware output and user-agent tagging; Claude Code alone drives about 40k users and 49M requests, with Codex close behind, as coding agents become the dominant Hub clients.

title: NVIDIA releases open Nemotron 3 Ultra 550B MoE for long-running agents
summary: NVIDIA's Nemotron 3 Ultra is a 550B-parameter MoE with 55B active, hybrid Mamba-Transformer layers, NVFP4 quantization across Hopper, Blackwell, and Ampere, and 30% lower cost-to-completion on agentic benchmarks.

title: Adobe and NVIDIA rebuild Photoshop and Premiere Pro for RTX Spark
summary: Adobe and NVIDIA extend their partnership to optimize Photoshop, Premiere Pro, and new AI agents for the 1-petaflop RTX Spark superchip, targeting 2x faster editing, effects, and Firefly workflows on Windows PCs.

title: ByteDance's Doubao launches paid Pro tier in China
summary: ByteDance introduces Doubao Pro at 68-500 yuan per month, the first paid tier for China's most-used AI assistant, with monthly actives dipping 6.07M and a planned Force Conference rollout of deeper AI shopping features.

title: Google DeepMind launches Gemma 4 12B unified encoder-free multimodal
summary: Gemma 4 12B Unified is an 11.95B open-weight model that drops vision and audio encoders in favor of joint text-image-audio decoding, hits 77.2% on MMLU Pro and 72.0% on LiveCodeBench v6, and runs on a 16GB laptop.

title: Meta launches Meta Business Agent and Business Agent Platform
summary: At its Conversations event in London, Meta rolls out Meta Business Agent across WhatsApp, Instagram, and Messenger for more than a million businesses, alongside a Business Agent Platform that connects to Shopify, Zendesk, and Shopee.

title: OpenAI introduces GPT-Rosalind for life sciences research
summary: OpenAI's first life-sciences model series lands in research preview with Amgen, Moderna, the Allen Institute, and Thermo Fisher, plus a free Codex Life Sciences Research Plugin that connects to more than 50 scientific data sources.

title: xAI ships Grok Imagine 1.5 image-to-video in preview
summary: grok-imagine-video-1.5-preview turns a single image into 720p video with camera moves, atmosphere, and physics, stitches multiple shots into longer scenes, and is available now via the xAI API.

title: Alibaba ships Qwen3.7-Plus multimodal agent model on Bailian
summary: Qwen3.7-Plus adds image and video understanding, deep reasoning, tool invocation, and autonomous iteration to the 3.7 family on Model Studio; its preview ranks #16 in Vision Arena and works with Claude Code, OpenClaw, and Qwen Code.

title: Anthropic expands Project Glasswing to 150 critical-infra orgs
summary: Anthropic opens Claude Mythos Preview to about 150 vetted organizations across 15+ countries covering power, water, healthcare, and communications, alongside a Claude Security product for general code scanning.

title: Microsoft ships seven in-house MAI models led by MAI-Thinking-1
summary: At Build 2026 Microsoft AI unveils MAI-Thinking-1, MAI-Code-1-Flash, MAI-Image-2.5, MAI-Transcribe-1.5, and MAI-Voice-2, with the 5B coding model rolling out as a default in VS Code GitHub Copilot and Foundry in private preview.

title: Perplexity unveils hybrid local-server inference orchestrator at Computex
summary: Perplexity's Personal Computer reasons per-subtask about local vs cloud execution on Intel Core Ultra Series 3 and Nvidia RTX Spark, keeping sensitive data on-device while routing hard reasoning to frontier cloud models, rolling out in July.

title: OpenAI frontier models and Codex go GA on Amazon Bedrock
summary: GPT-5.5, GPT-5.4, and Codex are now generally available on Amazon Bedrock with the Responses API, pricing matched to OpenAI direct, usage counted toward AWS commitments, and GPT-5.4 added to GovCloud (US-West).

title: MiniMax ships M3, the first open-weight model with 1M-token context and native multimodality
summary: MiniMax's M3 is the first open-weight model to combine frontier coding (59% on SWE-Bench Pro, surpassing GPT-5.5 and Gemini 3.1 Pro), a 1M-token context window via the new MSA sparse attention, and native image and video input; priced at $0.30-$0.60 per million input tokens, with open weights and a technical report due on Hugging Face within 10 days.

title: Anthropic confidentially files draft S-1 for proposed IPO
summary: Anthropic submits a draft S-1 registration statement to the SEC, opening the path to a public offering once the review completes, while the company continues to expand enterprise deals and Claude partnerships.

title: NVIDIA launches open Cosmos 3 omnimodel for physical AI
summary: Cosmos 3 is the first fully open mixture-of-transformers omnimodel that reasons and generates text, images, video, ambient sound, and action, with the Cosmos Coalition of Agile Robots, Black Forest Labs, Generalist, LTX, Runway, and Skild AI.

title: NVIDIA Vera is the first CPU purpose-built for AI agents
summary: NVIDIA's 88-core Vera CPU claims 1.8x task-completion speed over x86 and is being adopted by Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, ByteDance, CoreWeave, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure across standalone servers and Vera Rubin systems.

title: Mistral unifies Le Chat and Vibe CLI into one long-running agent
summary: At the AI Now Summit, Mistral folds Le Chat and Vibe CLI into a single Vibe agent with Work and Code modes, parallel remote coding sessions, and a new VS Code extension, available on the Pro, Team, and Enterprise plans.

title: Oracle Cloud Infrastructure joins the Arm AGI CPU ecosystem
summary: At COMPUTEX, Oracle Cloud Infrastructure commits to Arm's AGI CPU alongside Meta, OpenAI, SAP, Cloudflare, SK Telecom, Cerebras, and ByteDance, targeting more efficient rack-scale infrastructure for agentic AI workloads.
